title: Factorization of the pre-quotient wedge map
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $0\to A\xrightarrow{f}B\xrightarrow{g}C\to0$ a short exact sequence of module sheaves. Let $r_1,r_2,r_3\in\mathbb N$, $r_2=r_1+r_3$, with $A$ finite locally free of rank $r_1$ [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module]. Write $T=(\bigwedge^{r_1}A)\otimes(\bigwedge^{r_3}B)$ and $Q=(\bigwedge^{r_1}A)\otimes(\bigwedge^{r_3}C)$ using [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power]. Suppose morphisms $q:T\to Q$ and $\psi:T\to\bigwedge^{r_2}B$ are given. For every open $U$ and tuples $a\in A(U)^{r_1}$, $c\in B(U)^{r_3}$ suppose $q_U((\bigwedge a_i)\otimes(\bigwedge c_j))=(\bigwedge a_i)\otimes(\bigwedge g_U(c_j))$ and $\psi_U((\bigwedge a_i)\otimes(\bigwedge c_j))=\bigwedge(f_U(a_1),\ldots,f_U(a_{r_1}),c_1,\ldots,c_{r_3})$. Then there is $\varphi:Q\to\bigwedge^{r_2}B$ with $\varphi\circ q=\psi$.

proof.text: Obtain the canonical tensor exterior quotient epimorphism for S.g, which is epi by short exactness. The comparison theorem conjugates the official quotient by the canonical exteriorSheafPowerIso tensor isomorphisms, preserving the wedge-section formula.

Compare the given q with that canonical map on pure wedge tensors using identity lift extensionality, and transport its Epi instance. The retirement compatibility theorem exteriorSheafTensor_lift_hom_ext transports this invocation through the canonical exteriorSheafPowerIso to the official exteriorPower/wedge theorem, preserving the statement.

Tensor the canonical exteriorSheafPowerIso comparisons for the source and target of q, obtaining eB and eC with their forward and inverse pure-wedge formulas. Set q′=eB.inv ≫ q ≫ eC.hom and ψ′=eB.inv ≫ ψ. The given q formula gives the official pure-wedge formula for q′. The inverse formula, the prescribed ψ formula and full-rank wedge vanishing show that ψ′ kills every quotient relation. Apply the official exterior tensor kernel criterion to obtain kernel.ι q′ ≫ ψ′=0. The map kernel.ι q ≫ eB.hom is killed by q′, so lift it to kernel(q′), precompose the vanishing, and cancel eB.hom ≫ eB.inv to obtain kernel.ι q ≫ ψ=0.
Descend ψ through the epimorphism q by Abelian.epiDesc and use comp_epiDesc for the defining factorization equation.

theorem determinant_wedge_quotient_factor {X : Scheme.{v}}
    (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact) (r₁ r₂ r₃ : ℕ)
    (hr : r₂ = r₁ + r₃) [S.X₁.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank r₁]
    (q : exteriorSheaf S.X₁ r₁ ⊗ exteriorSheaf S.X₂ r₃ ⟶
      exteriorSheaf S.X₁ r₁ ⊗ exteriorSheaf S.X₃ r₃)
    (ψ : exteriorSheaf S.X₁ r₁ ⊗ exteriorSheaf S.X₂ r₃ ⟶ exteriorSheaf S.X₂ r₂)
    (hq : ∀ (U : X.Opens) (a : Fin r₁ → S.X₁.val.obj (op U))
      (c : Fin r₃ → S.X₂.val.obj (op U)),
      q.val.app (op U)
        (tmulSection (exteriorSheafSection S.X₁ r₁ U a)
          (exteriorSheafSection S.X₂ r₃ U c)) =
        tmulSection (M := exteriorSheaf S.X₁ r₁)
          (N := exteriorSheaf S.X₃ r₃) (U := U)
          (exteriorSheafSection S.X₁ r₁ U a)
          (exteriorSheafSection S.X₃ r₃ U (fun i ↦ S.g.val.app (op U) (c i))))
    (hψ : ∀ (U : X.Opens) (a : Fin r₁ → S.X₁.val.obj (op U))
      (c : Fin r₃ → S.X₂.val.obj (op U)),
      ψ.val.app (op U)
        (tmulSection (exteriorSheafSection S.X₁ r₁ U a)
          (exteriorSheafSection S.X₂ r₃ U c)) =
        exteriorSheafSection S.X₂ r₂ U
          (fun i ↦ Fin.append (fun j ↦ S.f.val.app (op U) (a j)) c (Fin.cast hr i))) :
    ∃ φ : exteriorSheaf S.X₁ r₁ ⊗ exteriorSheaf S.X₃ r₃ ⟶ exteriorSheaf S.X₂ r₂,
      q ≫ φ = ψ
